title: White-field key visual, large figure left, name plate lower-right
use: Bright release image where the character is the visual; text is a single plate on the side opposite the figure mass.

fonts.latinDisplay: lettering.cjs: code-drawn glyphs (A-Z, 0-9, space and / \ - _ + . , : ; [ ] < > | # % ! ? ' " & €), rendered as paths; other characters make the slot fall back to the CJK font and are reported
fonts.licence: Source Han Sans/Serif and Noto Sans/Serif CJK: SIL Open Font License 1.1
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. Install them where the SVG or PNG is rendered. check measures <text> with an advance model calibrated in headless Chrome against Noto Sans / Serif CJK SC at the weights the layouts use; other fonts can be wider.

bg.use: white field (Endfield KV largest cluster L* median 94.8)

letter_width.note: code-drawn display lettering: glyph width / cap height

letter_chamfer.note: display lettering corner cut / cap height

letter_stencil.note: display lettering stencil gap / cap height (0 = off)

accent_max_share.note: accent-colour area budget as a share of the canvas; measured on the render

guides.note: show safe zones, figure zones and alignment lines in the output

figure.note: figure + weapon, may cross under the plate edge

relations: The name plate is a solid white ground (readable) and sits opposite the figure's mass.
One fluorescent accent plus one secondary accent.
decoration: Accent shards (our own shapes, not traced), white fade at the bottom.
changesFromStudy: Label and name share one inset (0.015W; the study had 0.012W and 0.015W).
Figure keep-out zone is the figure mass (0.03-0.63W), not the whole slot, which may run under the plate edge.

provenance.corpus: ignoredone's space gallery of official Arknights / Arknights: Endfield promotional art (© HYPERGRYPH), reference only, never redistributed
provenance.method: Our own structural skeleton from measured proportions (median of eye-annotated layout boxes, Lab colour measurements). No traced artwork, logos or official text; image and logo areas are hatched placeholder slots.
provenance.samples: Endfield EF059 measured at full size; EF052 and XEF10 of the same type
measured: Endfield KV_OPERATOR: vivid pixels median 11.6%, fluorescent yellow median 2.4%; title over figure > 30% in 1/4
provenance.summary: Endfield EF059 measured at full size; EF052 and XEF10 of the same type; docs/research/arknights-endfield-template-study.md
